chars.SHADI: SHADI: a man in his thirties wearing a light blue fitted shirt with rolled sleeves, beige chino trousers, brown leather loafers and a silver wristwatch.
chars.GF: GIRLFRIEND: a young woman wearing a bright red summer dress, big round black sunglasses pushed up on her head and gold hoop earrings.
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a woman wearing a long green traditional Moroccan kaftan and a cream headscarf.
chars.OWNER: LANDLORD: a chubby middle-aged man wearing a grey striped djellaba, a white knitted cap and yellow babouche slippers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On a sunny seaside promenade in Mohammedia, Morocco, with the ocean and white apartment buildings behind. The GIRLFRIEND hangs on SHADI's arm laughing happily, while SHADI looks over his shoulder nervously, worried someone might see them. Comic guilty tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Next to a parked car on a Moroccan street, SHADI holds a phone to his ear with an annoyed shocked face, while the GIRLFRIEND crosses her arms and pouts impatiently beside him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a car, SHADI scrolls through a social media app full of apartment listing photos on his phone, focused; the GIRLFRIEND leans over his shoulder pointing excitedly at the screen.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the door of a modern seaside apartment, the LANDLORD hands a set of keys to SHADI with a strangely wide, sly smile, while SHADI takes the keys looking pleased and slightly suspicious.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a bright modern furnished living room with a big window to the sea, SHADI and the GIRLFRIEND dance and laugh carelessly; on a bookshelf in the corner a tiny black object with a small red light glows unnoticed.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the entrance of a cosy Moroccan family home in Rabat, the WIFE welcomes SHADI home with a warm happy smile and open arms, while SHADI smiles back with a forced, guilty grin, carrying a weekend bag.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a modern engineering office with blueprints and a computer, SHADI sits relaxed at his desk with a coffee cup, working calmly, colleagues in the blurred background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the same office, SHADI stares at his phone screen in total horror, eyes wide, mouth open, sweat drops flying, the coffee cup tipping over on the desk. The phone screen shows only a blurry play button video thumbnail, no text.
